text: Unlike Pipit-5, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Kestrel-9 is January 21, 2027. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Kestrel-9 applies to Pipit-5, the retirement date differs. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Dunlin-3 listens on port 6505; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.

Unlike Ibis-3, whose pager rotation is handled elsewhere, the pager rotation of Avocet-7 is Avery Dunmore. Nobody should assume the pager rotation of Avocet-7 applies to Ibis-3, the pager rotation differs. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
Unlike Plover-4, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Dunlin-3 is the Prism team. Nobody should assume the owner of Dunlin-3 applies to Plover-4, the owner differs.
Ibis-3 was granted a budget of $1650k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Pages from Kestrel-9 land on the pager rotation of Lucia Ivanova before anyone else.

Unlike Plover-4, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Ibis-3 is December 20, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Ibis-3 applies to Plover-4, the retirement date differs. An older draft of this note was archived.
Plover-4 has one owner, the Quill team, which approves each release and keeps the runbook current. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Finance fixed the budget of Pipit-5 at $4015k, reviewed every quarter. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.

Unlike Avocet-7, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Kestrel-9 is $1385k. Nobody should assume the budget of Kestrel-9 applies to Avocet-7, the budget differs. An older draft of this note was archived.
Plan around the retirement date of Plover-4: January 20, 2029 is when it goes dark. An older draft of this note was archived.
Expect throttling at the rate limit for Ibis-3, which is 1750 requests per minute.
Avocet-7 reaches its retirement date on September 23, 2029, so every consumer has to migrate before then.
The primary datacenter of Pipit-5 is Dublin; failover is handled by operations.
The owner of Pipit-5 is the Compass team, and every change to Pipit-5 goes through their review.

Finance fixed the budget of Avocet-7 at $860k, reviewed every quarter.
